properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: Dennis, MS
Location: 80 LOCK AND DAM RD.
Location2: TOMBIGBEE WATERWAY- JAMIE L WHITTEN LOCK AND DAM
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL: CRUDE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: SAVAGE INLAND MARINE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 34.521012, -88.320207 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 58800 gallon
Report Description**THIS REPORT IS RELATED TO NRC REPORTS 1257565 AND 1257566** THE NATIONAL RESPONSE RECEIVED UPDATED INCIDENT INFORMATION VIA USCG NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER E-MAIL. REPORT IS AS FOLLOWS: A BARGE BEING TOWED BY TUG ALLIDED WITH THE JAMIE L WHITTEN LOCK AND DAM, DAMAGING A CARGO TANK WHICH RESULTED IN THE DISCHARGE OF CRUDE OIL INTO THE TOMBIGBEE WATERWAY. 1400 BARRELS HAVE DISCHARGED AND THE AFFECTED TANK CONTAINS 6700 BARRELS. AT THIS TIME, ONLY MINOR SHEENING WAS OBSERVED OUTSIDE THE LOCK WITH NO REPORTED PRODUCT ESCAPING. THE WATERWAY HAS BEEN CLOSED, AND A SAFETY ZONE HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED FROM MILES 410 TO 414.

THE HOME OWNER DUG A FIRE PIT AND THE STEEL CASING WAS AT THE BOTTOM OF THE FIRE PIT. THE HOME OWNER HAD A FIRE IN THE FIRE PIT CAUSING THE 1/2 INCH PLASTIC SERVICE LINE TO MELT. THIS CAUSED THE GAS TO TRAVEL IN THE OLD STEEL LINE TO TRAVEL TO THE RESIDENCE. THE HOME OWNER SMELLED GAS THE NIGHT BEFORE AND THE DAY OF AND DID NOT CALL THE OPERATOR. THE MORNING OF THE EXPLOSION THE HOME OWNER TRIED TO LIGHT A CIGARETTE CAUSING THE EXPLOSION. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: CALLER STATES THERE WAS A FIRE AND EXPLOSION AT A RESIDENTIAL HOME. THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR NATURAL GAS TO RELEASE FROM A DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE TO THE ATMOSPHERE. CALLER STATES THERE 4 INJURIES SENT TO THE HOSPITAL BUT NO FATALITIES. properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 1070938 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: BARBERS CHEMICALS INC
properties.content:
Report Details

Incident Time: 2008-01-01 12:00:00
Nearest City: Sharpsville, PA
Location: 950 WEST MAIN STREET
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE (15% OR LESS
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: BARBERS CHEMICALS INC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.260800, -80.487609 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 4630 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ABOUT 5 YEARS AGO, AN EMPLOYEE OF BARBER"S CHEMICALS, INC., WAS FILLING SMALL BULK CONTAINERS WITH LIQUID CHLORINE (OR SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE). IN SOME TYPE OF DISTRACTION, HE OPENED THE VALVE ON THE END OF A 2" HOSE TO FILL THE NEXT CONTAINER AND THEN PROMPTLY LEFT FOR LUNCH. THE CHEMICAL TANK FROM WHICH THIS SMALL BULK CONTAINER WAS BEING FILLED HOLDS AS MUCH AS 5,000 GALLONS OF THIS CLASS 8 CORROSIVE OXIDIZER. WHEN HE RETURNED FROM LUNCH, HE FOUND THAT THE ENTIRE 5,000 GALLON CHEMICAL TANK HAD EMPTIED ONTO THE GROUND. THE INCIDENT WAS REPORTED TO HIS BOSS, OWNER OF BARBER"S CHEMICALS, HOWEVER, HE CHOSE NOT TO REPORT THIS INCIDENT TO ANY PROPER AUTHORITIES - AND THE THREAT OF THE LOSS OF EMPLOYMENT IS LIKELY WHAT HAD KEPT HIS EMPLOYEES QUIET UP UNTIL NOW. AFTER SEEING THE PROBLEM IN WEST VIRGINIA, IT SPARKED NOT ONLY MY MEMORY BUT MY EMPATHY FOR PRIVATE CITIZENS. MAYBE WORSE, THIS CHEMICAL PLANT WAS BUILT ON TOP OF A KNOWN WASTE DUMP. THE AREA THAT THESE SMALL BULK TANKS ARE FILLED IN USED TO BE A WAREHOUSE FOR TRUCKS. NOT LONG AFTER IT WAS BUILT, IT CRUMBLED UNDER THE WEIGHT OF ITS FOUNDATION, BUILT ON TOP OF GARBAGE AND WASTE MATERIALS WHICH MAY HAVE INCLUDED REFRIGERATORS (A KNOWN SOURCE OF FREON) AND OTHER POTENTIALLY HARMFUL SUBSTANCES, THAT, WHEN COMBINED WITH CHLORINE, FORM POWERFULLY DANGEROUS AND CARCINOGENIC COMPOUNDS. THESE COMPOUNDS CAN THEN BE LEACHED INTO GROUNDWATER AND CONSUMED BY HUMANS THROUGH THE USE OF AREA WELLS. FURTHER, THE MAJORITY OF THE SURROUNDING AREA IS SERVED BY A WATER COMPANY THAT IS JUST DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS CHEMICAL PLANT. THE RIVER THAT FLOWS JUST BEHIND THE CHEMICAL COMPANY, THE SHENANGO RIVER, MAY HAVE BEEN CONTAMINATED WITH ANY NUMBER OF DANGEROUS COMPOUNDS.
